actor_report:
Observations: ISSUE_9.md reports that page_count(11, 10) returns 1 and should return 2. The owner classifies the issue as trivial-fix and authorises a direct change to utils/paging.py plus a regression test in tests/test_paging.py. POLICY.md lets the implementing actor make and close trivial-fix changes with no separate review. Under STDO-UP-007 and Condition-Based Closure, independent review is therefore not a required conjunct here. The cause is in utils/paging.py:4, which uses floor division (total // per_page), so any partial final page is dropped.

Work: I propose replacing the floor division with ceiling division, -(-total // per_page). This stays in integer arithmetic, so there are no float precision issues. The existing ValueError guard for per_page <= 0 is kept. The proposed results are 11/10 -> 2, 20/10 -> 2 (existing test_exact), 0/10 -> 0 (existing test_empty), 1/10 -> 1 and 19/10 -> 2. I added test_partial_last_page to tests/test_paging.py as the regression test. The issue's grant names exactly these two files, and both edits stay inside them.

Unresolved, per FOUNDATIONS Result algebra and RF-012: (1) I have no execution tools. I ran no tests and applied no edits, so the predicate 'tests pass on the edited workspace' is not_performed/indeterminate. (2) The edit effect is not_started from my side; the host applies the edits. (3) Closure under Condition-Based Closure requires the fix and the regression test to be satisfied on the applied candidate. The implementing actor may record closure under POLICY.md, but closure stays indeterminate until the host's test run establishes it. Self-review here is authoring evidence only. (4) Behaviour for a negative total is not specified by the issue or the tests, and this fix changes it: for example, page_count(-5, 10) goes from -1 to 0. I did not add validation for negative totals because that would change meaning outside the stated issue. It is recorded as repricing input for the owner.
